parameter: phase12_success_as
source: a PHASE1|PHASE2 construct clears the phase-2 and phase-3 transitions only (base) or all three (low)

parameter: entry_multiplier
source: new constructs entering per year relative to the 2021 to 2025 rate

parameter: new_disease_share
source: share of projected CAR-T approvals that open a disease not already served (assumption, D013)

parameter: new_disease_pool
source: annual US eligible flow of a newly opened CAR-T disease: log-uniform over the observed indication flows (F034, F039); base is the geometric mid

parameter: eu_pop_ratio
source: Europe (EBMT survey area) eligible flow over the US flow: population ratio with similar incidence (assumption)

parameter: row_share
source: rest of world as a share of US plus Europe patients: 2024 registry rows give Japan 503 (JDCHCT, provisional), China about 300 to 600 a year from sponsor statements (F046), Saudi Arabia 41, Singapore 12; Australia, Canada and Korea unpublished

parameter: us_share_gt
source: US share of worldwide patients for one-time therapies (no sponsor reports a true US split; n=0 observed)

parameter: count_basis
source: revenue-derived patient counts carry the class net-to-list factor 0.76; the calibration range 0.63 to 0.86 (F024) moves counts by this factor

parameter: centre_growth
source: annual growth of qualified CAR-T centres: European EBMT rate 2021 to 2024 (base); US reporting centres 159 (CIBMTR 2020) to 171 (FACT 2026) (low)

parameter: us_centres_2026
source: US centres: FACT-accredited institutions with an immune effector cell service (171, read 2026-09-06); Kite 150+, Carvykti 140+ (F046)

parameter: throughput_max
source: patients per centre-year at capacity: Germany 2024 (base); Europe average (low)

parameter: access_scale
source: cumulative incidence of funding per system scaled within its bootstrap band (F047)

parameter: diffusion_source
source: Bass parameters drawn per product from the shrunk per-product set (F049); structural alternative: pooled curve
